Purpose and scope
Add an opt-in disposable-PostgreSQL benchmark built from accepted generated releases, with increasing corpus sizes up to current inventory/query bounds. Separate ingestion/index construction from query timing, cold/warm runs and selection persistence. Capture EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS for selective and broad predicates and exact-input observations.

Acceptance proof
Machine-readable report includes seed, revision/source fingerprint, PostgreSQL version, hardware, cardinalities, repetitions, latency distribution, row counts and query plans. Results still match the oracle. State measured limits and likely bottlenecks; do not turn local timings into an SLA or add flaky timing thresholds to ordinary CI.

Start here
scripts; modules/integration/src/test/scala/sanctity/postgres; modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/ScientificSql.scala; docs/evidence

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: Q4: Measure scientific and observation query cost on reproducible bounded cohorts
